hero.title: Your digital life deserves a plan, too.
hero.text: Keep passwords, accounts and documents in one encrypted vault, and make sure they reach the right people when it matters.

problem.title: What happens to your digital assets when you are gone?

day1.text: Family cannot find your accounts or passwords.

month1.text: Banks and platforms lock access without proof.

month6.text: Subscriptions keep charging, data starts expiring.

forever.text: Photos, documents and memories are lost.

how.title: Four steps. Then it runs quietly in the background.

create.title: Create your vault
create.text: Store assets and legal documents, encrypted before they are saved.

people.title: Name your people
people.text: Choose an Executor and the Beneficiaries who will receive each asset.

checkin.title: Check in regularly
checkin.text: The Dead Man's Switch only starts counting when you stop checking in.

handover.title: Verified hand-over
handover.text: A Legal Verifier reviews the case before the vault is ever unlocked.

security.title: Built so that nobody can open it early.

encrypted.title: Encrypted at rest
encrypted.text: Every asset and document is encrypted with a master key the database never sees in plain text.

noFalseAlarm.title: No false alarms
noFalseAlarm.text: Reminders are sent before the switch triggers, so a missed check-in never unlocks anything.

human.title: Human verification
human.text: Unlocking requires a Legal Verifier to approve the request and sign with a one-time code.

items.OWNER: Builds the vault, sets the switch and decides who receives what.
items.EXECUTOR: Is notified when the switch triggers and starts the hand-over.
items.BENEFICIARY: Verifies identity and receives only the assets assigned to them.
items.LEGAL_VERIFIER: Reviews documents and signs off before anything is released.

staff.q: Can LegacyVault staff read my assets?
staff.a: No. Assets are encrypted before storage and are only decrypted for the assigned beneficiary after verification.

forget.q: What if I forget to check in?
forget.a: You receive reminders before the deadline. The switch only triggers after the full grace period has passed.

unlock.q: Who decides when the vault is unlocked?
unlock.a: A Legal Verifier must approve the request and sign it. The switch alone cannot release your assets.

change.q: Can I change my beneficiaries later?
change.a: Yes. As long as the vault is active, you can update people and assets at any time.

closing.title: Start your plan today. It takes ten minutes.
closing.text: Peace of mind for you, a clear path for the people you love.

preview.title: Your whole digital legacy on one screen
preview.text: See your readiness, what to do next and handover progress as soon as you sign in.
